leadText:
Yumiko Sudou (Japanese: ) is the creator of several Pokémon manga born on May 19 in the . Her manga, usually aimed at children, have been published by Shogakukan.

Before the January issue of Bessatsu CoroCoro Comics, she would prefer a pen-name, such as "Yumi". She is also associated with Televi-kun, a monthly manga magazine aimed at boys. Her other Nintendo manga series have included and .
